user.title: Light bulb replacement
user.description: First add the new bulb to Home Assistant using its normal integration. After setup, open **Configure** to replace a bulb or restore the last replacement.

abort.already_configured: The wizard is already installed. Use Configure on the integration.
abort.single_instance_allowed: The wizard is already installed. Use Configure on the integration.

select.title: Select bulbs
select.description:
The old bulb may be offline. The new bulb must be registered, enabled and available. Groups cannot be replaced.

For ZHA copying: wake battery remotes and keep the old bulb in ZHA during scanning. Other devices are scanned too, because incoming bindings live on the sender.

To copy Zigbee configuration, select one backend only. For Zigbee2MQTT, both bulbs must belong to the same bridge connected to Home Assistant MQTT.

data.copy_zha: Discover and copy ZHA bindings and Zigbee groups
data.copy_z2m: Discover and copy Zigbee2MQTT bindings and Zigbee groups

confirm.title: Review replacement
confirm.description:
**{old} → {archived}** (name: {name}_OLD, disabled).

**{new} → {old}** (name: {name}). Area ID: {area}. Area, labels, aliases and custom icon are copied.

**Resolve before replacing:** {blockers}

**Different light capabilities:** {capabilities} (`capabilities` means different color/dimming/effect support). Review scenes.

Take a Home Assistant backup. References to the original entity ID will target the new bulb. History is not migrated. Clean up references to the new bulb’s previous ID manually. Zigbee bindings/groups, external systems and dynamic templates cannot be verified here. Hardware device IDs and unique IDs stay unchanged. Pause affected automations during replacement; state changes will occur.

operation_failed.title: Zigbee operation did not complete
operation_failed.description: Read the error below. Continue to the menu. If a replacement needs recovery, select Undo / recover last replacement and keep the affected devices awake.

z2m.title: Zigbee2MQTT connection
z2m.description:
Use the MQTT base topic from your Zigbee2MQTT configuration (normally `zigbee2mqtt`). Home Assistant must already be connected to the same MQTT broker. No broker credentials are needed here.

Leave endpoint fields empty for automatic selection. If a device has several light channels and the wizard cannot identify the selected channel, enter the corresponding numeric endpoint from Zigbee2MQTT.

Discovery uses cached bridge records and may miss unrecorded bindings. No bindings are changed during discovery.

error.invalid_light: Select two registered lights (not groups). The new light must be enabled.
error.new_unavailable: The new light must be available in Home Assistant first.
error.archive_exists: The proposed _old entity ID is already in use. Rename that entity first.
error.recovery_required: An operation needs recovery. Return to the menu and restore the last replacement. Check the logs if recovery fails.
error.selection_changed: The selection or its settings changed. Close this dialog and select the lights again.
error.unsupported_references: Resolve the listed device/registry references before replacing. These do not follow an entity ID.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm that you have read the preview and taken a Home Assistant backup.
error.replacement_failed: Replacement failed. Original registry settings have been restored. Check the logs.
error.storage_failed: The recovery journal could not be saved. Check available disk space and logs.
error.recovery_conflict: A recorded entity is missing, moved, or its original ID is occupied. Resolve the conflict before restoring.
error.nothing_to_restore: There is no replacement to restore.
error.new_device_area: The old bulb has no area, but the new bulb inherits one from its device. Clear the new device area first, or assign an area to the old bulb.
error.zha_unavailable: ZHA must be configured and running before scanning.
error.zha_lights_required: Select light entities on two different physical ZHA devices. Groups and virtual lights are not supported.
error.zha_device_missing: A selected ZHA device or endpoint is missing. Check ZHA and select the lights again.
error.zha_read_failed: A device did not return a valid binding or group table. Wake battery devices and scan again.
error.zha_invalid_table: A binding table was incomplete or changed during pagination. Wake the device and scan again.
error.zha_incompatible: The replacement does not support the listed clusters or Zigbee profile. Manufacturer-specific bindings need manual setup.
error.zha_incomplete: Some devices could not be read. Rescan with them awake, or explicitly accept copying only the known bindings and groups.
error.zha_network_changed: The ZHA network or selected endpoints changed. No further radio changes will be made. Return to the menu and check ZHA.
error.zha_write_failed: A Zigbee binding/group command failed. Automatic rollback was attempted; check the recovery status before retrying.
error.zha_verification_failed: The device did not confirm the expected binding/group on read-back. Automatic rollback was attempted; check recovery before retrying.
error.binding_backend_conflict: Select either ZHA or Zigbee2MQTT copying, not both.
error.z2m_unavailable: Home Assistant MQTT must be connected and the selected Zigbee2MQTT bridge must be online.
error.z2m_invalid_topic: Enter an exact MQTT base topic without leading/trailing slashes, whitespace or wildcards.
error.z2m_invalid_data: Zigbee2MQTT bridge metadata is missing or invalid. Check the bridge version, MQTT permissions and retained bridge topics.
error.z2m_timeout: Zigbee2MQTT did not respond in time. Check the MQTT base topic, bridge connection and device availability. If a write was started, review recovery before retrying.
error.z2m_device_missing: A selected Zigbee2MQTT device or endpoint is missing. Keep both bulbs registered on the selected bridge.
error.z2m_lights_required: Select MQTT-discovered lights on two different physical devices on this Zigbee2MQTT bridge. Groups, other MQTT lights and cross-network copying are not supported.
error.z2m_endpoint_required: The selected light channel cannot be mapped safely. Return to bulb selection, choose Zigbee2MQTT copying again and enter the correct numeric endpoint for each bulb.
error.z2m_incompatible: The replacement lacks a required cluster or uses an unsupported binding. Resolve the listed bindings manually before replacing.
error.z2m_incomplete: Explicitly accept that discovery uses cached Zigbee2MQTT records and copies only known entries.
error.z2m_network_changed: The Zigbee2MQTT bridge, coordinator or network changed. No further writes will be sent. Restore the original bridge before recovery.
error.z2m_write_failed: Zigbee2MQTT rejected a command or did not confirm the requested binding/group operation. Rollback was attempted; review recovery before retrying.
error.z2m_verification_failed: Updated Zigbee2MQTT bridge records did not confirm the requested change. Rollback was attempted; review recovery before retrying.
error.z2m_read_failed: Zigbee2MQTT discovery failed. Check MQTT connectivity, retained bridge records and Home Assistant logs.

progress.scan_zha: Reading binding tables across the ZHA network. This can take a few minutes. Keep battery remotes awake. No bindings are changed during discovery.
progress.execute_zha: Copying or restoring bindings and group memberships, and checking device responses. Keep devices awake. If interrupted, use Undo / recover last replacement.
progress.scan_z2m: Reading cached Zigbee2MQTT bridge records and checking that the bridge responds. No device binding tables are scanned and no bindings are changed.
progress.execute_z2m: Copying or restoring Zigbee2MQTT bindings and groups, checking command responses and updated bridge records. Keep affected devices awake. If interrupted, use Undo / recover last replacement.
